title: The Great Teacup Regatta
description: For the spring regatta, the harbor brings out its best porcelain. A young sailor waves as a flower-painted cup takes the lead.
alt: A young sailor waves from a flower-painted porcelain teacup with a teal sail. Other teacup boats follow along a stone breakwater lined with spectators.
pairing: An imagined spring harbor holiday × a regatta of porcelain teacups
